Inside the warehouse

Real window openings with missing panes and jagged glass, a damaged rooflight, rolled-steel trusses, stairs and guardrails. Dirt, damp and oil collect around worn machinery. The complete architecture remains separate from every loose prop.

Independent architectural source · Warehouse GLB

What the shift left behind

Each new prop has its own packed Blender source, engine export and three reviewed angles. The office also reuses existing independent chair, phone, mail and bin assets.

Blender 4.5.1 LTS · Cycles / OptiX · 128 samples at 1800 × 1200 for the environment; 80 samples at 1000 × 1000 for props. Original textured PBR surfaces, packed images and embedded Y-up exports. A linked assembly preserves all source assets.

Standalone art collection. Gameplay placement and collisions need engine scene setup. Daylight, exterior paving and airborne dust belong to the Blender presentation and are excluded from GLBs. The overview is a temporary cutaway; the saved source retains every wall and roof panel.
